# Psalm 76 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. With-stringed-instruments. A-psalm of-Asaph. A-song. Known in-Judah God, in-Israel great his-name.

**2** And-was in-Salem his-booth, and-his-den in-Zion.

**3** There he-broke the-flaming-arrows-of the-bow, shield and-sword and-battle. Selah.

**4** Resplendent you-are, majestic from-mountains-of prey.

**5** Were-plundered the-stout-of-heart, they-slept their-sleep, and-not found all the-men-of might their-hands.

**6** At-your-rebuke O-God-of Jacob, were-stunned both-chariot and-horse.

**7** You, fearsome you-are, and-who can-stand before-you from-time-of your-anger?

**8** From-heaven you-caused-to-be-heard judgment; the-earth feared and-was-still,

**9** When-arose for-judgment God, to-save all the-humble-of the-earth. Selah.

**10** For wrath-of man will-praise-you; remainder-of wrath you-will-gird-on.

**11** Vow and-pay to-YHWH your-God; all around-him let-them-bring gifts to-the-Fearsome-One.

**12** He-cuts-off the-spirit-of rulers; fearsome to-kings-of the-earth.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **76:2**: Salem (shalem) = Jerusalem; 'booth' (sukko) and 'den' (me'onato) — rare terms for God's dwelling, evoking both fragility and ferocity.

- **76:10**: Notoriously difficult verse: 'wrath of man will-praise-you' — human fury paradoxically serves divine purposes.

— EMET
